pages.body:
Why This Book Exists


Have you ever found something hidden? Maybe you found a treasure in the attic. Maybe you found a letter in an old book. Maybe you found a clue in a puzzle. It was there all along. You just had to look. You just had to dig. You just had to discover it.


The Bible is full of hidden things. It is full of treasures. It is full of clues. One of the most important clues is hidden in the very first book. It is hidden in the very first story. It is hidden in a garden. It is a prophecy. It is a promise. It is a seed. It is the seed of the woman. And it points to Jesus.


This book is for the curious. It is for the spiritual seeker who wants to discover the hidden things. It is for the person who wants to dig deeper. Over the next 30 days, we are going to look at this ancient prophecy. We are going to see what it means. We are going to see how it unfolds. We are going to see how it points to Jesus. And we are going to discover the seed of the woman.


The Value You Will Get


By the end of this book, you will not see Genesis as just a story of beginnings. You will see it as a story of prophecy. You will see it as a story of promise. You will see it as a story of the seed. You will understand the ancient prophecy. You will understand the hidden meaning. You will understand why it matters today. You will have a new confidence in your faith. You will have a new love for your Bible. And you will have a new appreciation for the seed of the woman.


How to Use This Guide


This is a 30 day journey. Each day takes about 10 minutes. Read the hook. Read the ancient text. Read the fulfillment. Read the verdict. Read the resonance. Read the prayer. If you are not sure how to pray, just read the words out loud. God hears honest words. He is not lo...

pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever planted a seed? You put it in the ground. You cover it with dirt. You water it. You wait. You cannot see it. It is hidden. But you know it is there. You know it is growing. You know it will produce fruit. The Bible talks about a seed. It talks about a hidden seed. It talks about a seed that will produce fruit. And that seed is Jesus.


The Ancient Text (OT)
"And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your offspring and hers; he will crush your head, and you will strike his heel." - Genesis 3:15 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


This is the first prophecy in the Bible. It is the first promise. It is the first seed. God is speaking to a snake. But He is speaking to the devil. He says a descendant of a woman will come. That descendant will crush the serpent's head. It is a hidden seed. It is a hidden promise. It is a hidden prophecy.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"But when the set time had fully come, God sent his Son, born of a woman, born under the law..." - Galatians 4:4


Jesus is the descendant. He is the seed. He was born of a woman. He came to crush the serpent's head. He came to defeat the devil. The hidden seed has grown. The hidden promise has been fulfilled.


The Verdict
The seed of the woman is Jesus. The pattern is exact. The prophecy is precise. The seed is Jesus.


The Resonance
Do you feel like your life is hidden? Do you feel like you are buried? Do you feel like you are not growing? Remember the seed. Remember the promise. God can take what is hidden and make it grow. God can take what is buried and bring it to life.


The Prayer
God, thank you for the hidden seed. Thank you for the hidden promise. Thank you for Jesus. Help me to trust the seed. Help me to trust the growth. Help me to trust the promise. Amen.

pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever seen a seed become a tree? Have you ever seen a promise become a reality? Have you ever seen a prophecy become a person? The seed of the woman is a prophecy. It is a promise. It is a person. That person is Jesus.


The Ancient Text (OT)
"And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your offspring and hers; he will crush your head, and you will strike his heel." - Genesis 3:15 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


This is the first prophecy. This is the first promise. This is the first seed. God spoke to the serpent. He spoke to the devil. He said a descendant would come. He said a hero would come. He said a rescuer would come. That descendant is Jesus. That hero is Jesus. That rescuer is Jesus. He is the seed of the woman.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"But when the set time had fully come, God sent his Son, born of a woman, born under the law..." - Galatians 4:4


Jesus is the seed. He was born of a woman. He came to crush the serpent's head. He came to defeat the devil. He came to save the world. The seed of the woman is Jesus.


The Verdict
The seed of the woman is Jesus. The pattern is exact. The prophecy is precise. The seed is Jesus.


The Resonance
You have seen the seed. You have seen the promise. You have seen the prophecy. You have seen Jesus. Now what? You can trust the seed. You can trust the promise. You can trust Jesus.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being the seed of the woman. Thank you for coming to crush the serpent's head. Thank you for defeating the devil. Thank you for saving the world. Help me to trust the seed. Help me to trust the promise. Help me to trust you. Amen.



END MATTER


The 30-Day Seed Challenge
You have journeyed through 30 days of the seed of the woman. Now what? I challenge you to read the Gospel of Matthew. It is 28 chapters. It tells the story of Jesus from the perspective of a Jewish believer. As you read, look for the seed. Look for the promise. Look for Jesus.


A Note on Faith
The seed is evidence. It is evidence of a divine plan. But evidence does not save you. The seed points to a person. The seed points to Jesus. You can understand the seed and still miss the Savior. The invitation is for your heart. Jesus said, "Here I am! I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in." The seed is on the table. The door is open. It is your choice.


About the Author
Christine A. writes for the spiritually curious. He is passionate about showing people the hidden wisdom of the Bible. He lives with his family and enjoys good coffee and long conversations with skeptics. He believes that honest questions deserve honest answers.


Coming Next: The Original Story
If you enjoyed this journey, the next book in the series goes deeper. The Original Story takes a 30 day look at how the first pages of the Bible reveal the ultimate hero. It is for the seeker who wants to go further.
